description.value: The Copper Mug claims to be the oldest pub in Penticton and the second oldest in British Columbia, having operated since 1974. Located in the Safeway Plaza on Main Street, it serves a full food menu alongside daily chef's specials and house-made soups. A lively weekly events calendar — including Friday music trivia, Thursday wing nights, and Sunday brunch — makes it a neighbourhood anchor in a town that sits on popular cycling routes.
